name: Dumbbell Goblet Squat
steps: Hold one dumbbell vertically against the upper chest with both hands under its upper head.
Stand with feet about shoulder width and toes slightly out.
Sit down between the hips while keeping the weight close.
Push through the whole foot to stand.
cues: Keep the dumbbell close to the chest.
mistakes: Holding the weight away from the body.
Letting heels lift at the bottom.
breathing: Inhale while lowering; exhale while standing.
adaptation: Dumbbell substituted for the source kettlebell; muscle data retained.
